result.rationale: TopicEmbed.import appends `link: "#{url}"` with the URL interpolated directly into a single-quoted HTML attribute. The only validation is `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which permits single quotes, spaces, and markup (e.g. `http://x/' onmouseover='...`), enabling attribute breakout and arbitrary markup injection. The post is then created with cook_method raw_html, and Post#cook returns raw unmodified, so the injected HTML is stored and rendered verbatim. This is a real, verifiable XSS/injection defect introduced by this diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the code appends an HTML snippet containing `"#{url}"` into `contents` without escaping (`app/models/topic_embed.rb` around the `imported_from` line). The only validation is `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which allows URLs containing single quotes or other characters that can break out of the single-quoted `href` attribute and inject markup/attributes. This is especially dangerous because imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly, bypassing the rendering/sanitization pipeline, and the embed view renders with `raw post.cooked`.
